name: Gilgamesh Tablet XI flood account
source_label: Standard Babylonian Epic of Gilgamesh, Tablet XI

surviving_manuscript_date.note: The standard Babylonian epic is preserved in first-millennium BCE copies including the Nineveh library tradition.

tradition_internal_claim.note: Utnapishtim recounts a primordial flood; no historical calendar date is supplied.

dating.dating_summary: Tablet XI belongs to the standard Babylonian Gilgamesh tradition preserved in first-millennium BCE witnesses; its flood section reworks older Mesopotamian flood material, so its ultimate source history is older than the surviving manuscripts.

notes: Added for Phase 7 to model the well-supported Atraḫasīs → Gilgamesh flood relationship and to keep any possible Gilgamesh → Genesis connection separate from stronger Atraḫasīs evidence.
